scope: Chromium CDP multi-touch in the browser formation review. Blur cleanup is event-dispatched; not Unity or physical-device certification.

checks.name: Same-slot secondary release cannot cancel the primary finger’s 600ms removal hold
A secondary slot never starts removal after the primary finger releases
Primary drag survives another finger’s release and moves one guardian without losing the ghost early
Same-preset secondary release cannot cancel a valid save or turn its release into a load
One gesture owns formation across slot/preset controls; the other finger cannot save or remove
Cancel, blur and navigation clear both fingers’ pending work; a fresh primary hold still works
